verdict.rationale: Parsec documents a "Virtual monitors" feature and multi-monitor streaming, and it has an Android client. Together these suggest a connecting device could view an additional display rather than a mirror of an existing one, but the evidence never describes using a tablet or spare device to extend the desktop. Missing for 10: any documentation of the tablet-as-extended-display workflow, detail on how virtual monitors work or what they are limited to, and hands-on or independent confirmation.

support.subject: As a power user, a tablet or spare device works as an additional display that extends the desktop, not only a mirror of it
